description: This file implements functionality to extract and replace struct samplers in shader code, including traversing and modifying the abstract syntax tree (AST) for shader programs. It defines classes and functions for manipulating shader tree nodes related to struct samplers, including removing sampler declarations, replacing sampler references, and handling function parameters and calls involving struct samplers.

classes.name: Traverser
classes.description: A class that traverses the shader AST to remove sampler declarations, replace sampler references, and modify function signatures involving struct samplers.

classes.name: CreateStructSamplerFunctionVisitor
classes.description: A class that creates new function definitions with expanded struct sampler parameters.

classes.name: GetSamplerArgumentsVisitor
classes.description: A class that generates new argument lists for function calls by expanding struct sampler parameters.

classes.name: StructSamplerFunctionVisitor
classes.description: A base class for visiting function parameters related to struct samplers, used by the above visitors.

methods.name: GetStructSamplerParameterType
methods.description: Helper to get the type of a struct sampler parameter.

methods.name: ReplaceTypeOfSymbolNode
methods.description: Replaces the type of a symbol node with the extracted struct sampler type.

methods.name: ReplaceTypeOfTypedStructNode
methods.description: Replaces the type of a typed struct node, handling nested struct indexing.

methods.name: createStructSamplerFunction
methods.description: Creates a new function with expanded struct sampler parameters.

methods.name: getStructSamplerArguments
methods.description: Generates new argument list for function calls with expanded struct sampler parameters.
